reviews.author: Suneetha Thota
reviews.text:
I had been struggling with significant hair loss for over a year and had visited multiple doctors without much improvement. A friend recommended Dr. Sowmya, and I’m so glad I took that advice.
From the very first consultation, Dr. Sowmya was thorough and patient. She didn’t just prescribe generic treatments — she took the time to understand the root cause, ordered the right investigations, and explained everything in simple terms. She identified that my hair loss was related to hormonal imbalance and nutritional deficiency, something no one had caught before.
The treatment plan she put together was systematic — a combination of topical therapy, nutritional supplementation, and dietary guidance. She also followed up regularly and adjusted the plan based on my response. Within three months, I noticed a visible reduction in shedding, and by six months, new growth was clearly visible.
What sets Dr. Sowmya apart is her genuine interest in her patients’ wellbeing. She is approachable, evidence-based in her approach, and never makes you feel rushed. Highly recommend her to anyone dealing with hair loss — she truly delivers results.

reviews.author: Sk Rahamthulla
reviews.text:
⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐

I consulted Dr. Sowmya for psoriasis, a condition I had been struggling with for years. The constant itching, scaling, and recurring flare-ups were affecting not only my skin but also my confidence and daily life. After trying various treatments with only temporary relief, I decided to visit Dr. Sowmya based on a recommendation.

From the very first consultation, I felt I was in safe hands. Dr. Sowmya took the time to understand my medical history, examined my condition thoroughly, and explained the nature of psoriasis and the treatment options in a very clear and patient-friendly manner. Her approach was both professional and compassionate, which immediately gave me confidence in the treatment plan.

Over the following months, I noticed a significant improvement in my symptoms. The itching reduced, the plaques started clearing, and my flare-ups became much less frequent. What I appreciated most was the regular follow-up and the genuine concern shown for my progress.

The clinic is well organized, and the staff are courteous and supportive. I am truly grateful to Dr. Sowmya for helping me manage my psoriasis effectively and improve my quality of life.

I highly recommend Dr. Sowmya to anyone dealing with psoriasis or other chronic skin conditions. Her expertise, dedication, and caring attitude make her an exceptional dermatologist.

Before I gave 1 star to this clinic as I didn't see any results after the Laser treatment for my Dark spots.

Now I'm changing to 3 stars. Doctor recognised my Ferritin and Vit D levels were very low. I appreciate this.

But I have few suggestions, hope hospital/Doctor look into this.

1. Please give privacy to the patient while discussing problem with the doctor. I feel uncomfortable to show my problem infront of staff. I visited multiple Dermatologists in Guntur/Bengaluru, no doctor allow their staff when patient is inside.

2. I don't think reception staff following proper queue. As a customer I'm expecting First come first serve, hope this will be corrected.

3. I knew bringing physical prescription/OP form makes easy when I come to follow up. But unfortunately I can't able carry physical papers everytime, I can show only in the mobile. Accept this and go digital.

Hope all these will be corrected before my next hospital visit. So that I can increase my rating here. Thanks!

reviews.author: Imran Shaik
reviews.text:
Absolutely the worst service ever!

Two months ago, I took my mother to Dr. Sowmya Skin & Laser Clinic for a skin problem, trusting them with her care. They took a skin sample from my mother and assured us that the biopsy report would arrive soon. However, even after two whole months, there has been no update, no follow-up, and no sense of responsibility from their side.

Every time we called or visited to ask about the report, we were met with vague responses, delays, and complete negligence. The staff seems utterly careless, with no concern for the anxiety and stress a patient goes through while waiting for critical medical results. Despite multiple attempts to get clarity, we received nothing but excuses and indifference.

Frustrated and exhausted by their unprofessional behavior, we had no choice but to visit another hospital, where things were handled properly and on time. This experience has been nothing short of a nightmare, and I deeply regret trusting this clinic in the first place.

If you care about your health and peace of mind, STAY AWAY from this place! The lack of responsibility, professionalism, and basic empathy here is unacceptable.
